answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Each submission hangs on the lotus of a task receipt, and the onyx is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, idle agents bleed standing. Reaching the zephyr of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
